name: iridescent liquid blobs ripple in front of a scrolling label wall
looks: A wall of outlined words and small sunburst icons scrolls sideways behind glossy, iridescent liquid blobs that stretch, pinch and merge in front of it, their surfaces rippling with a rainbow sheen. A small mono caption names the rendering technique and step count.
build: metaball-morph-style SDF blobs (raymarched or goo-filtered circles under a threshold filter) with a rainbow/iridescent reflective material whose hue shifts with surface normal; a ticker-tape-marquee strip of repeated labels and icon glyphs scrolls behind at a steady linear speed; a small mono caption states the render method and step count.
sound: A low, wet wobble under the blobs merging and separating, with a soft whoosh behind the scrolling label wall.
prompt: Scroll a wall of small repeated labels and icon glyphs sideways in the background, and in front of it let a few glossy, rainbow-sheened liquid blobs stretch, pinch and merge into one another, with a small caption naming the render technique, so the craft and the look are shown together.
